nora: noticed a spike after running a replay for eu-agg-hours 2026-03-12 00:00-02:00. totals ~2x expected.
eli: job id?
nora: rply-11422, ran via quick CLI, dedupe not set.
infra-bot: replay rply-11422 started by nora - status: running - writes: enabled - mode: full_recompute
sam: quick CLI defaulting dedupe=false again. we need a guard.
claire: immediate step: pause writes so we don't commit bad aggregates. run a canary with dedupe=true and shard sampling.
nora: pausing: `./replay update rply-11422 --writes disabled` -> done.
infra-bot: rply-11422 writes disabled by nora - job continues in compute-only mode
eli: we don't have sample_rate in internal API. we only support explicit shard list. can we add sample_rate + a `recompute_tag` for telemetry?
sam: yes add sample_rate and `dry_run`/`skip_writes` flags; scheduler should honor `priority:canary` and route to spot pool. also add quota cap (max_tokens) on job proto.
claire: console UX: show a modal if dedupe=false for windows >=30m; add a "canary sample" toggle and badge [CANARY] on jobs. PR sketch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/8719
ela: telemetry: tag outputs with `meta.recompute_tag=canary-1766000000` so dashboards can filter. ensure panel queries exclude tagged canaries by default.
sam: for now I'll kick a manual canary via internal endpoint (shard_sample:0.1,dedu pe:true,priority:canary). queuing rply-11423.
infra-bot: rply-11423 queued - priority:canary - max_tokens:200000
claire: add CLI guard too (warn if dedupe=false && window>30m). we'll draft RFC.
nora: thanks. will post canary diffs when ready.
